test_batch_concat: test the batch_concat utility that concatenates batched JAX arrays and nested structures into a single array
test_mapreduce: test the mapreduce decorator that applies a function across JAX arrays and reduces results to a scalar
test_get_from_first_device: test the get_from_first_device utility that extracts data from the first device of sharded JAX arrays
test_JaxUtilsTest: test the JaxUtilsTest class that validates all JAX utility functions in the acme.jax.utils module
run_JaxUtilsTest: run the absltest suite for JAX utilities including batch_concat, mapreduce, and get_from_first_device tests
